design/generator-34.全文可讲字数: Words you can speak for the whole deck
design/generator-34.建议每页正文上限: Suggested body text limit per slide
design/generator-34.每要点可用时间偏紧（8~15 秒），建议页内要点不超过 4 条，并把细节放入备注: Time per bullet is tight (8-15 seconds): keep at most 4 bullets per slide and move details into the speaker notes.
design/generator-34.一、逐页节奏分配（按页面类型加权，抽样展示）: 1. Per-slide timing allocation (weighted by slide type, sampled)
design/generator-34.按「字高(mm) ≈ 观看距离(m) ÷ 5」估算：若最后一排距幕布 X 米，正: Estimated with "cap height (mm) ≈ viewing distance (m) ÷ 5": if the back row is X meters from the screen, the minimum body size is about 20 pt × X ÷ 1.4 (about 113 pt covers 8 m with the current parameters).
design/generator-34.单页动画总时长建议 ≤: Total animation duration per slide should be ≤
design/generator-34.（每页时长的 15%），入场动画 0.3~0.6 s/个、页间切换约 0.5 s: (15% of the slide duration), entrance animations 0.3-0.6 s each, transitions about 0.5 s.
design/generator-34.淡入、平滑切换，每页 ≤2 个动效: Fade in, smooth transitions, at most 2 effects per slide
design/generator-34.缩放、图表生长，数据页强调动效可到 0.8 s: Zoom and chart growth; emphasis effects up to 0.8 s on data slides
design/generator-34.推进、浮入，演示页避免逐条动画排队: Push and float in; avoid queuing per-bullet animations
design/generator-34.淡出、简单切换，动效越少越显严谨: Fade out and simple transitions; fewer effects look more rigorous
design/generator-34.数字滚动、放大强调，关键数字页给足停留: Number roll and zoom emphasis; give key-number slides enough dwell time
design/generator-34.擦除、缩放强调，互动页预留操作时间: Wipe and zoom emphasis; leave time for interaction on interactive slides
